question: What was ordered quantity per order for the full year 2025? Use the recorded order date for the 2025 scope.

action.reason: The user requested the ordered quantity per order for the full year 2025, using the recorded order date. The metricflow tool can directly provide this metric at the requested grain and time scope.

metric_definitions.ordered_quantity_per_order: Ordered item quantity divided by number of orders; combines both fact semantic models.

action.answer: For the full year 2025, the ordered quantity per order was 2.805393 (units per order, rounded to six decimals). This means that, on average, each order contained approximately 2.81 items. The population includes all orders recorded with an order date in 2025, regardless of order status. The unit is item units per order. This metric helps understand the average basket size per transaction for the year.
